# Pilot 2 on GitHub's standard runners, 21 October 2026, from arch. Workflow .github/workflows/nupkg-rebuild.yml,
# which runs dependencies/experiments/nupkg/rebuild.py on the runner at the commit the run started from.
gh workflow run nupkg-rebuild.yml -R peterjuulm/Speciale2026 -f recipe=<recipe> -f runner=<runner>
gh run download <run id> -R peterjuulm/Speciale2026 -D /private/tmp/nupkg-pilot/gh/<run id>
# Each run's output folder, without packages (text only), is copied to <package>-<runner>-run<N>-<run id>/ here.
#
# run id       recipe                            runner        commit
# 39596681330  serilog-4.2.0-windows.toml        windows-2022  633ecac
# 39596686629  serilog-4.2.0-windows.toml        windows-2025  633ecac
# 39596691641  guardclauses-5.0.0-windows.toml   windows-2022  633ecac
# 39596697042  cronos-0.9.0-windows.toml         windows-2022  633ecac
# 39597050142  serilog-4.2.0-windows.toml        windows-2022  6e7e55c
# 39597055965  serilog-4.2.0-windows.toml        windows-2025  6e7e55c
# 39597130182  guardclauses-5.0.0-windows.toml   windows-2022  b355751

# Report diffs, on arch with the report tool of the pilot (R in ../arch/kommando.txt): the shipped DLL
# (and its PDB, where the package has one) out of each .nupkg, then
$R <dll> [<pdb>] > report-<tfm>-<nugetorg|A>.txt
diff report-<tfm>-nugetorg.txt report-<tfm>-A.txt
